title: On pluricanonical locally conformally almost Kähler metrics
summary: On an almost complex manifold $(M,J)$, a pluricanonical locally conformally almost Kähler (LCAK) metric $g$ is induced by a locally conformally symplectic structure $(F,θ)$ of the first kind, characterized by the fact that $Dθ$ is $J$-anti-invariant and that the image of the Nijenhuis tensor is $g$-orthogonal to the distribution spanned by $\{θ^\sharp,Jθ^\sharp\}$, where $θ$ is the Lee form and $D$ is the Levi-Civita connection. On a compact complex manifold, pluricanonical locally conformally Kähler (LCK) metrics have parallel Lee form. The same conclusion holds for LCK Chern--Ricci flat…
